paragraphs: Spotify is a service for music, podcasts and audio books. People can use it for free with ads, or they can pay for Premium. On October 22, the company shared its results for the third quarter of 2026. The results highlight strong growth in users and in money.

In the quarter, 788 million people used Spotify each month. That was 11% more than a year earlier. The number of paying Premium users grew 9% to 306 million. Of all monthly users, 499 million used the free version with ads. That group grew 12%. According to Spotify, the growth was widespread. Premium users grew in every region of the world.

Revenue rose 16% from a year earlier, to 5.0 billion euros. The gross margin reached 33.0%. The gross margin is the part of revenue that is left after paying the direct costs of the service. It was the highest margin Spotify has ever had in a third quarter. Investors were happy. On the day of the report, the stock closed more than 11% higher.
The music news site Hypebot said the results demonstrate that Spotify can earn more without losing growth in users.

Spotify has two chief executives. One of them, Alex Norström, said: "This was a quarter where we did what we said." He added that Spotify continues to grow and take a bigger share of the market. The other, Gustav Söderström, talked about agents. Agents are intelligent computer programs that do jobs for people. In his view, people use agents for things they would rather not do. But nobody asks an agent to give them a short version of a song. He believes Spotify can do well in a time of intelligent agents.

Spotify also wants to help people who make shows and other content earn more. In 34 markets, eligible creators can now offer special content to fans who pay for a membership. Another program pays podcast creators based on how much people listen. It is coming to more than 35 new markets, including Brazil, Mexico, Italy and Spain. So these programs are becoming more widespread.

Spotify also launched a beta version of a feature called Taste Profile. A beta is an early test version. It shows users how Spotify understands their taste in music, podcasts and books. Users can also change it. For now, only Premium users aged 18 or older in the United States are eligible.

The company is gradually bringing audio books to more countries. It was in 22 markets, and it will gradually reach more than 180 by the end of 2026. Spotify also has a new program for emerging artists. An emerging artist is a new artist who is just starting to become known. Each year, about 10,000 such artists will get help. Spotify also has a collaboration with the fashion brand Coach. As part of the collaboration, a tour is visiting colleges in the United States, the United Kingdom, Japan and South Korea.
